mapper.select: SELECT p.proj_id AS "projectId",p.cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",c.clnt_nm AS "customerName" FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id ORDER BY p.proj_id

SELECT to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') AS "month",b.proj_id AS "projectId",sum(b.sply_amt) AS "amount" FROM tb_bl_bill b JOIN tb_pj_proj p ON p.proj_id=b.proj_id WHERE p.ctrt_type_cd='TK' AND b.cncl_yn='N' AND b.bill_dt >= to_date(#{fromMonth},'YYYYMM') AND b.bill_dt < to_date(#{toMonth},'YYYYMM')+interval '1 month' GROUP BY to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM'),b.proj_id ORDER BY "month","projectId"
